standard: Every action benefiting a named private party (contracts, purchases, renewals, change orders, piggybacks, zoning/land use/variances/plats/site plans/development agreements, leases and sales of public land, grants and fee waivers to named organizations, settlements, easements, licenses). Excludes proclamations, ceremonial items, appointments, internal staffing, government-only items. Built without reference to donors.

gaps.issue: Regular meeting held (agenda and packet posted) but no minutes attached to any later agenda; private-party agenda items listed with roll null
Minutes read are the draft attached to the 2026-10-28 agenda; not yet approved
Meeting not yet held as of 2026-10-24; agenda posted but not included
Several consent-agenda votes (2025-05-14, 2025-05-28, 2025-06-11) and the 2025-08-25 lease vote record a 5-0 or 4-0 roll but no mover or second; mover and second are null
Consent items carry the roll of the single consent-agenda vote; pulled items carry their own vote

Applicants for site plans, plats, special exceptions and rezonings (3400 NW 135 St, 14301 NW 27 Ave, 2466 Ali Baba Ave, 13449 NW 42 Ave, 1700 Service Road, 13060 Cairo Lane, 3570/3530/3450 NW 135 St) are not named in the minutes or titles; the contractor on the seven Cairo Lane/NW 127 St change orders and the NW 127 St water-main change order is not named either

Budget hearings (2025-09-09, 2025-09-24, 2026-09-08, 2026-09-23) and special meetings of 2025-11-14 and 2025-11-24 were read; they hold only millage, budget and code items, with no private-party actions
Interlocal agreements, state and federal grants, mutual aid, RFP issuances naming no vendor, code amendments, scholarships and union contracts are excluded under the standard
